skills.name: Convert to Common Denominator
skills.definition: Convert fractions to a common denominator, including finding the least common denominator and generating equivalent fractions.

skills.name: Subtract Fractions
skills.definition: Subtract fractions with like denominators by subtracting numerators and keeping the denominator.

skills.name: Simplify Fractions
skills.definition: Reduce fractions to lowest terms by dividing numerator and denominator by their greatest common factor.

skills.name: Handle Mixed Numbers
skills.definition: Interpret and manipulate mixed numbers, including separating whole and fraction parts, rewriting whole numbers as mixed numbers with zero fraction, converting improper fraction parts to proper form, and subtracting whole numbers.

skills.name: Borrow
skills.definition: Borrow from the whole part when fraction subtraction yields a negative result, by decreasing the whole by 1 and adding the denominator to the fraction before subtracting.
